annotations.text:
Option A — Refined current
Same structure as today, tightened: money moved to the top with big revenue/profit tiles, date in the header, one primary action. Closest to the existing code, so cheapest to build.
Tradeoff: still one long scroll.

Option B — Data-first
KPI row up top with context lines (vs yesterday, margin), then a two-column desktop layout: goals + attention on the left, automation and month summary in a sidebar. Most glanceable on a big screen.
Tradeoff: needs a responsive collapse for phone widths.

Option C — Daily briefing
Leads with a greeting, one hero profit number, quick actions, and a prioritized "Up next" task list with per-task actions. Most personal — reads like a morning briefing.
Tradeoff: automation stats are demoted to a footer strip.
